data.title: 双叶理央 · 科学顾问改了灯位
data.description: 学校剧社找理央帮忙核对灯位，顺便让她试穿缎面演出裙。她站在地板胶带的交叉处，量出灯圈偏移的距离，再把妨碍读数的头纱拨到背后。那套方领白裙意外地适合做这次舞台曝光参考。
data.action: 捏着量布软尺对准地面的舞台标记，把头纱拨到背后。
data.promptProse: During a school theatre lighting rehearsal, she measures the offset from a tape mark on the floor and brushes the veil away from her view. A sharp circle of stage light shows exactly where the mark has fallen outside the beam.
data.animaCaption: She is checking the spotlight position before the rehearsal continues.
